behavior: The eight retired skills live under vault 90_archive/skills/ with status archived and are gone from 00_meta/skills/
verification: v=${VAULT_PATH:-$HOME/Projects/knowledge}; for s in dispatching-parallel-agents project-maturation research-prompt verification-before-completion audit writing-plans executing-plans enrich-us; do grep -q '^status: archived' "$v/90_archive/skills/$s/SKILL.md" && [ ! -e "$v/00_meta/skills/$s" ] || exit 1; done

behavior: No record, trigger, dependency-map entry, requires field or persona roster names a retired skill
verification: for s in dispatching-parallel-agents project-maturation research-prompt verification-before-completion audit writing-plans executing-plans enrich-us; do [ ! -e harness/skills/$s ] || exit 1; done; ! grep -qE '^requires:.*\b(dispatching-parallel-agents|project-maturation|research-prompt|verification-before-completion|audit|writing-plans|executing-plans|enrich-us)\b' harness/skills/*/SKILL.md && cd cli && go test ./internal/harness -run '^(TestEverySkillTheRouterNamesHasARecord|TestEveryDeclaredSkillHasARecord)$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS: ' | grep -qx 2

behavior: The reviewer, planner and builder rosters are the slimmed ones, every existing severity is preserved, and at least 16 of 18 trigger rules still resolve to a persona
verification: cd cli && [ "$(go run ./cmd/dotf harness resolve-skills ../harness/agents/reviewer/AGENT.md)" = '[adversarial-review, cyclomatic-complexity, pr-review-triage]' ] && [ "$(go run ./cmd/dotf harness resolve-skills ../harness/agents/planner/AGENT.md)" = '[spec, new-ticket, prd-to-issues]' ] && [ "$(go run ./cmd/dotf harness resolve-skills ../harness/agents/builder/AGENT.md)" = '[test-driven-development, test, systematic-debugging, cyclomatic-complexity]' ] && [ "$(awk 'NR>1 && /^---$/{exit} NR>1' ../harness/agents/reviewer/AGENT.md | grep -c 'enforce: warn')" -eq 3 ] && [ "$(awk 'NR>1 && /^---$/{exit} NR>1' ../harness/agents/planner/AGENT.md | grep -c 'enforce: warn')" -eq 1 ] && [ "$(awk 'NR>1 && /^---$/{exit} NR>1' ../harness/agents/builder/AGENT.md | grep -c 'enforce: warn')" -eq 2 ] && go test ./internal/harness -run '^TestRoleJoinDrift$' -count=1 -v | grep -q '^--- PASS: TestRoleJoinDrift '

behavior: adversarial-review, spec and new-ticket carry the folded rules
verification: grep -q '^## Evidence before claims' harness/skills/adversarial-review/SKILL.md && grep -q '^## Closing pass (Definition of Done)' harness/skills/adversarial-review/SKILL.md && grep -q 'code-level checklist' harness/skills/adversarial-review/SKILL.md && grep -q '^## Planning the tasks' harness/skills/spec/SKILL.md && grep -q '^## Executing the tasks' harness/skills/spec/SKILL.md && grep -q '^## Enrich a thin item' harness/skills/new-ticket/SKILL.md

behavior: go test, compile-harness --check, the doctrine budget test and the suites this change touches pass
verification: (cd cli && go test ./... -count=1 >/dev/null) && ./scripts/compile-harness.sh --check >/dev/null && bats tests/compile-harness.bats tests/agents-md.bats tests/skills-pipeline.bats tests/harness-suggest.bats >/dev/null

behavior: After deploy, no retired skill remains in any deploy target or the Copilot catalog
verification: for s in dispatching-parallel-agents project-maturation research-prompt verification-before-completion audit writing-plans executing-plans enrich-us; do for d in .claude/skills .gemini/skills .pi/agent/skills .copilot/skills; do [ ! -e "$HOME/$d/$s" ] || exit 1; done; [ ! -e "$HOME/.config/opencode/commands/$s.md" ] && [ ! -e "$HOME/.gemini/prompts/$s.md" ] || exit 1; done; ! grep -qE '^- \*\*(dispatching-parallel-agents|project-maturation|research-prompt|verification-before-completion|audit|writing-plans|executing-plans|enrich-us)\*\*|MUST consume: \[.*\b(dispatching-parallel-agents|project-maturation|research-prompt|verification-before-completion|audit|writing-plans|executing-plans|enrich-us)\b' "$HOME/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md" "$HOME/.claude/CLAUDE.md" "$HOME/.gemini/GEMINI.md"
